digest.component_or_area: scc LOC/size analyzer for code_health lens
propositions: A self-contained scc adapter produces the loc payload of AnalyzerResult from scc --format json output.
The parser flattens the two-level scc JSON (language groups then per-file Files entries) using Code and Location fields, keying files by repo-relative POSIX paths and computing max_loc.
The analyzer fails closed with Unavailable and a warning when scc is missing, exits non-zero, emits empty stdout, or returns unparseable JSON, never fabricating zeros.
A successful empty scc result ([]) yields AnalyzerResult with empty files and max_loc 0 rather than Unavailable.
The module stays independent of the grounding layer, using an injectable run runner so tests need no live scc.
The change adds only new files under analyzers/ so rollback is a clean delete with no existing files modified.
